evm.acceptance:
D=/tmp/morph/evm; mkdir -p $D; S=$(date +%s)-$$; L=$D/acc-$S.log
cp ethsc/evm.py $D/0-$S.py 2>/dev/null
cp tests/test_evm.py $D/1-$S.py 2>/dev/null
(
 set -e
 venv/bin/python -c "import ast,sys; [ast.parse(open(f).read(), f, feature_version=(3,9)) for f in sys.argv[1:]]" ethsc/evm.py tests/test_evm.py
 if grep -nE '^[[:space:]]*(import|from)[[:space:]]+(urllib|http|socket|requests|yaml|numpy|pandas|Crypto|eth_|web3)' ethsc/evm.py; then echo 'guard: ethsc/evm.py must import only the standard library and no network module'; exit 1; fi
 venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import sys
from ethsc.evm import disassemble, strip_metadata, extract_selectors, detect_proxy, build_skeleton
F = "tests/fixtures/"
def code(n):
    return bytes.fromhex(open(F + n).read().strip()[2:])
bad = []
def chk(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        bad.append("%s: got %r, want %r" % (name, got if len(repr(got)) < 400 else repr(got)[:400] + "...", want))
W = code("code_weth9.hex"); U = code("code_usdt.hex"); V2 = code("code_univ2_usdc_weth.hex")
V3a = code("code_univ3_usdc_weth_005.hex"); V3b = code("code_univ3_pool_e0554a47.hex")
LTa = code("code_launchtoken_4e67db19.hex"); LTb = code("code_launchtoken_40676634.hex")
C1 = code("code_clone_270df012.hex"); C2 = code("code_clone_3b2fac8e.hex"); C3 = code("code_clone_2ca7b61b.hex")
D7 = code("code_7702_04cfab85.hex"); BE = code("code_belle.hex")
chk("Disassemble 1", disassemble(W)[:3], [(0, 0x60, b"\x60"), (2, 0x60, b"\x40"), (4, 0x52, b"")])
chk("Disassemble 2", len(disassemble(W[:3081])), 1555)
chk("Disassemble 3", disassemble(bytes.fromhex("600161ff")), [(0, 0x60, b"\x01"), (2, 0x61, b"\xff")])
chk("Disassemble 4", disassemble(b""), [])
b, t = strip_metadata(W); chk("Strip Metadata 1", (len(b), len(t), t[:9].hex()), (3081, 43, "a165627a7a72305820"))
b, t = strip_metadata(V2); chk("Strip Metadata 2", (len(b), len(t), t[:9].hex(), "64736f6c6343000510" in t.hex()), (11241, 52, "a265627a7a72315820", True))
b, t = strip_metadata(V3a); chk("Strip Metadata 3", (len(b), t.hex()), (22130, "a164736f6c6343000706000a"))
chk("Strip Metadata 4", (strip_metadata(C1), strip_metadata(b"")), ((C1, b""), (b"", b"")))
chk("Extract Selectors 1", extract_selectors(W), ["0x06fdde03", "0x095ea7b3", "0x18160ddd", "0x23b872dd", "0x2e1a7d4d", "0x313ce567", "0x70a08231", "0x95d89b41", "0xa9059cbb", "0xd0e30db0", "0xdd62ed3e"])
chk("Extract Selectors 2", extract_selectors(U), "0x06fdde03 0x0753c30c 0x095ea7b3 0x0e136b19 0x0ecb93c0 0x18160ddd 0x23b872dd 0x26976e3f 0x27e235e3 0x313ce567 0x35390714 0x3eaaf86b 0x3f4ba83a 0x59bf1abe 0x5c658165 0x5c975abb 0x70a08231 0x8456cb59 0x893d20e8 0x8da5cb5b 0x95d89b41 0xa9059cbb 0xc0324c77 0xcc872b66 0xdb006a75 0xdd62ed3e 0xdd644f72 0xe47d6060 0xe4997dc5 0xe5b5019a 0xf2fde38b 0xf3bdc228".split())
s = extract_selectors(V2); chk("Extract Selectors 3", (len(s), "0x022c0d9f" in s, "0x0902f1ac" in s), (27, True, True))
s = extract_selectors(BE); chk("Extract Selectors 4", (len(s), "0xf7e58a63" in s, "0x78051f4d" in s), (14, True, True))
chk("Extract Selectors 5", (extract_selectors(C1), extract_selectors(b"")), ([], []))
p = {"kind": "eip1167", "target": "0x4181f37093e3a21a4e0d5ef355c5b1938cba5bfb"}
chk("Detect Proxy 1", (detect_proxy(C1), detect_proxy(C2)), (p, p))
chk("Detect Proxy 2", detect_proxy(C3), {"kind": "eip1167", "target": "0x8b72b9b8e544f944cdcdf0cdb6194f917ac1eba5"})
chk("Detect Proxy 3", detect_proxy(D7), {"kind": "eip7702", "target": "0x0000fb7702036ff9f76044a501ac1aa74cbab16b"})
chk("Detect Proxy 4", (detect_proxy(C1[:44]), detect_proxy(W), detect_proxy(b"")), (None, None, None))
chk("Build Skeleton 1", (sum(x != y for x, y in zip(V3a, V3b)), build_skeleton(V3a) == build_skeleton(V3b)), (74, True))
chk("Build Skeleton 2", (sum(x != y for x, y in zip(LTa, LTb)), build_skeleton(LTa) == build_skeleton(LTb)), (58, True))
Wf = bytearray(W); Wf[-5] ^= 0xFF; sk = build_skeleton(W)
chk("Build Skeleton 3", (sk == build_skeleton(bytes(Wf)), len(sk)), (True, 3081))
chk("Build Skeleton 4", build_skeleton(W) != build_skeleton(U), True)
for junk in (b"\x7f\x01", b"\xfe" * 7, bytes(range(256))):
    try:
        disassemble(junk); strip_metadata(junk); extract_selectors(junk); detect_proxy(junk); build_skeleton(junk)
    except Exception as e:
        bad.append("Tolerant Parser: %r raised on %r" % (e, junk[:8]))
print("\n".join(bad) if bad else "evm probe: 21 examples + tolerance OK")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PY
 venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_evm.py -q --tb=short
 venv/bin/python -m pytest tests -q --tb=short
) > $L 2>&1; rc=$?; cat $L; exit $rc
